title: Director of Operations
text:
Description:

The Director of Operations leads assigned day-to-day operational functions across Heartview locations and is responsible for consistent, efficient, safe, and accountable operations. The position partners with organizational leaders to strengthen operating systems, management reporting, staffing efficiency, patient access, and resource utilization while respecting established clinical and medical authority.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead and supervise the Bismarck, Cando, and Dickinson Site Directors, Director of Admissions, and Maintenance leadership.
* Provide leadership, guidance, and professional development to assigned managers and department leaders; establish clear performance expectations and accountability for results.
* Monitor staffing utilization, service capacity, workflows, patient-support functions, and operational performance across assigned locations.
* Partner with Heartview leaders to establish useful operating measures, reporting routines, key performance indicators, and practical accountability systems.
* Work with administrative and clinical leaders to improve patient flow and utilization of available services while respecting clinical and medical needs.
* Oversee maintenance, grounds, janitorial services, fleet operations, and preventive maintenance priorities.
* Identify operational gaps across residential, outpatient, and medication-assisted treatment services; collaborate with appropriate leadership to develop and implement solutions.
* Travel required 2 - 4 days per month.

**Why Work With Us?** At Heartview Foundation, we take pride in supporting not only our patients but also our team. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Generous **Paid Time Off (PTO)** for work-life balance.
* **401(k) with employer match** to support your financial goals.
* **100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision** insurance coverage for **employees.**
* **75% employer-paid health, dental, and vision** insurance coverage for **dependent(s).**
* **Paid holidays to recharge with loved ones.**
* Access to a confidential **Employee Assistance Program** (EAP).

Requirements:

**Qualifications:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, behavioral health, business administration, or a related field is **required**.
* Five years of progressively responsible healthcare, behavioral health, or substance use disorder treatment leadership experience is **required**.
* Experience supervising managers or department leaders is **required**.
* Experience managing multiple departments or locations, developing operational processes, and leading organizational improvements is preferred.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful completion of the pre-employment screening process.

At Heartview Foundation, every team member helps create a safe, recovery-oriented environment. We look for employees who are committed to recovery principles and healthy living, and who can demonstrate that commitment through their professional conduct and personal wellness practices. Because of the unique role we play in clients’ lives, staff must also respect professional boundaries, avoid conflicts of interest, and recognize the power differential that can exist not only between providers and clients but also among staff members. To ensure ethical standards are maintained, employees cannot be current participants in Heartview Foundation’s primary treatment programs. If an offer of employment is made, Human Resources will conduct due diligence to confirm the accuracy of this disclosure.

**Don't miss the chance to join a truly meaningful mission and team making a difference in others' lives every day.** Apply today and embark on a fulfilling career at Heartview Foundation!

**This posting will be open until filled.**
